lead.title: @huggingface/kernels ships 200+ WebGPU kernels for browser-based local AI
lead.summary: Hugging Face released @huggingface/kernels, a JavaScript library for loading and running optimized WebGPU kernels from the Hub, with an initial collection of 207 Apache-2.0 kernels. Against ONNX Runtime Web it showed up to 2.57x faster kernel performance by geometric mean, alongside a new browser-based Fleet benchmarking suite.

top_stories.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs on CPU at ~8 tok/s — 87GB GGUF benchmarked
top_stories.summary: An 87.2 GiB GGUF of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next hits roughly 8.3 tok/s decode on CPU-only llama.cpp and ~109 tok/s with full VRAM, with GPU-placed embeddings giving a large boost at long context.

top_stories.title: Home Assistant 2026.9 ships: local LLM direction continues
top_stories.summary: The September release adds child devices, a Matter network map, tile-card lighting and climate controls, and OpenStreetMap vector tiles, building on the 2026.8 llama.cpp and Ollama integrations that let local models drive devices with no cloud round-trip.

top_stories.title: Qualcomm and HUMAIN unveil Horizon Ultra AI PC at LEAP 2026
top_stories.summary: A Snapdragon X2 Elite AI PC with an 18-core Oryon CPU, Adreno GPU and Hexagon NPU designed to run models locally on-device, available for enterprise purchase from September 20, with a HUMAIN OS variant planned for 2027.

items.title: SinkPruner prunes visual tokens to cut multimodal LLM inference cost
items.summary: Sink-free visual token pruning that reduces the inference overhead of multimodal LLMs on long visual token sequences, tackling the cost of vision-centric and text-guided pruning strategies.

items.title: Qwen3.8-Next design paper: 125B sparse MoE beats its 397B predecessor
items.summary: Details the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next architecture — a 125B sparse MoE (6B activated) with n-gram embedding tables held off-accelerator and hybrid Gated DeltaNet/global attention — beating the 397B model on most benchmarks at a third the activated parameters and roughly a ninth of training FLOPs.

items.title: LatentPress compresses context into continuous memory tokens
items.summary: Compresses conversational histories and long documents into continuous memory tokens a frozen language model can read directly, cutting context memory footprint versus human-readable text or decoded images.

items.title: A mathematical theory of reusable neural bases for network compression
items.summary: The Linear Reusable Neural Bases Architecture (LRNBA) improves parameter efficiency to ease the memory-cost bottleneck in large-model training and inference.

items.title: DeepSeek opens weights for V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, first vision model in the V4 family
items.summary: A 305B sparse MoE with vision released under MIT license, the first downloadable checkpoint in the V4 family. Ships in FP8 (~168GB) with tokenizer and minimal PyTorch inference code; the API launched August 21 and weights followed ten days later.

items.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: first open-weight Qwen3.6 variant, agentic-coding MoE
items.summary: Alibaba released the 35B total / ~3B active multimodal sparse MoE under Apache 2.0, focused on agentic coding with a thinking-preservation feature and day-one support across vLLM, SGLang, Ollama and Unsloth GGUFs (~22-23GB RAM to run locally).

items.title: Qwen3.6-27B dense companion lands with 262K context
items.summary: Part of the first open-weight Qwen3.6 release, the 27B dense model scores strong agentic coding and reasoning results and is available in HF Transformers, vLLM, SGLang plus Unsloth GGUF/MTP and MLX-8bit quantizations for local hardware.

items.title: Fountain: open-source conversational API that gives your app a computer
items.summary: A self-hosted AGPL engine that spins up a sandboxed coding agent with repos, tools and credentials from a single prompt. Supports Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode runtimes, attaches MCP servers, and keeps conversations in your own Postgres.

items.title: Superagent — a local home for your coding agent (Mac)
items.summary: A free, MIT-licensed Mac app where a local coding agent lives: drives a real browser signed in as you, streams a live iPhone simulator, keeps chats across restarts, and runs fully on-device with no account and no telemetry.

items.title: mcptunnels — ngrok for MCP with OAuth 2.1
items.summary: MCP-shaped tunneling that gives a local stdio MCP server a public URL in one command, with OAuth 2.1-gated endpoints by default and a self-hostable relay. Bridges stdio to Streamable HTTP so remote clients like ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor can reach a server on your laptop.
